subject: Embeddings/rerank migration — orchestration, backfill queue & shard plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Anya Patel <anya@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings/rerank migration — orchestration, backfill queue & shard plan

Hi Anya (and team),

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Per our call, I sketched a pragmatic migration plan so your search+assistant stack can switch to the new embeddings + reranker with minimal downtime and predictable cost. The attached CSV has a 1k sample of the priming records we discussed.

High-level goals:
- Zero data loss: ensure every index document is either seeded or enqueued for backfill.
- Bounded regressor risk: run rerank evals on a sampled slice before cutover.
- Predictable window: keep < 30 min degraded queries during the cutover.

Proposed phases (short):
1) Preflight (this week): sampling, priming window plan, confirm vector DB shard mapping.
2) Dry run: small-wave backfill (5% of index) with smoke evals + rerank metrics.
3) Staggered backfill orchestration: queue-based worker waves by shard; warm-start priming before wave.
4) Cutover w/ fallback: route 10% traffic to new pipeline, monitor, then shift.

Open questions for you so we can finalize the orchestration doc:
- Which shards are read-only during the weekend window? (we need explicit write freeze windows per shard)
- Preferred maintenance window (your earlier note said weekend UTC — can you confirm a start/end?)
- Any internal constraints for concurrency on your VectorDB cluster (max 8 concurrent bulk loads)?

Attachments: priming_samples.csv (CSV, 1k rows)

Action items for Redwood (owners CC'd):
- Marissa: finalize the orchestration_plan.pdf and the shard-to-queue mapping.
- Ben: build smoke-test checklist and rerank eval script.
- Jordan: confirm client-side fallback policy and routing playbook.

I can send the orchestration doc by Friday EOD PT; please flag anything above that needs to change.

Thanks,

Soojín Lee
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin — this looks good at a glance. Couple quick clarifications: I copied our infra contact (infra@skybridge.ai) below for the shard and maintenance-window details.

Questions from infra:
- We can do a write freeze per shard but prefer earliest start: Sat 02:00 UTC (to minimize user impact).
- VectorDB cluster allows up to 10 concurrent bulk loads but we recommend 4 for consistent tail latencies.

From our product team: can the staggered waves be based on document age buckets (hot -> cold) rather than pure shard size? That would help keep the most-used docs available sooner.

We'll review the priming sample and flag any PII rows (should be none).

Subject: Re: Embeddings/rerank migration — orchestration, backfill queue & shard plan

Hi team — taking tasking and clarifying execution details. I attached a short runbook (indexing-runbook-v2.md) with the shard-to-queue mapping I built from Skybridge's exports. Key notes below:

- Wave assignment: 8 waves total; wave keys are (hot, warm, cold) by doc age then shard size. Hot docs get seeded first and then continuous KV-cache priming for 48h.
- Backfill workers: each worker will process queue batches of 250 docs; we recommend concurrency=3 per worker process when loading into the VectorDB because of the cluster tail latencies Anya mentioned.
- Fallback policy: any wave that exceeds a 15% rerank MRR drop triggers an automatic rollback and reroute to legacy pipeline.
- Data integrity: all writes to the vectorstore get journaled to S3 and a transaction marker is emitted. If a job fails, we re-enqueue the batch using the transaction id.

Attachment: indexing-runbook-v2.md (markdown)

Owners & timelines (rough):
- Marissa: finalize runbook + orchestration_plan.pdf (ETA Fri EOD PT).
- Ben: smoke-test checklist and rerank eval (ETA Mon EOD PT).
- Jordan: client-side fallback test harness + routing playbook (ETA Mon EOD PT).

Notes for Soojin: Let's sync on the maintenance window with Skybridge and land the exact UTC start before Friday so we can generate the DocuSign SOW for the weekend work.

-Marissa
Sr. Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, infra@skybridge.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embeddings/rerank migration — orchestration, backfill queue & shard plan

Hi Anya / infra team — updated plan attached (orchestration_plan.pdf). Summary of changes after internal sync:

- Maintenance window: Sat 02:00 UTC -> Sun 06:00 UTC (we propose a 28-hour window to stage waves; final active cutover operations limited to a 6-hour contiguous block you pick).
- Concurrency: we will target 4 concurrent bulk loads to VectorDB per cluster recommendations; worker concurrency configurable at runtime.
- Wave ordering: hot->warm->cold with an additional micro-wave for “recent-but-high-traffic” docs (age < 7d & top 1% of traffic).
- Sampling & rerank eval: Ben's team will run 10k query rerank evals per wave and send a short report (SMR/NRR, MAP@10 deltas). If MAP@10 drops > 0.02 for two consecutive waves we hold and evaluate.

Attachments: orchestration_plan.pdf, smoke-test-checklist.xlsx (checklist + pass/fail criteria).

Requested from Skybridge: please confirm the final 6-hour active cutover block within the maintenance window by EOD Thursday (we need to book the engineers + SRE). Also confirm whether we should disable autoscaling on the VectorDB during the active cutover (recommended: yes).

Best,

Soojín

Subject: Re: Embeddings/rerank migration — orchestration, backfill queue & shard plan

Thanks everyone — we reviewed the orchestration_plan.pdf and the smoke checklist. Confirming the active cutover block: Sat 2027-06-05 04:00 UTC -> Sat 2027-06-05 10:00 UTC (6 hours).

We accept the staging window and the four-concurrent-load recommendation. Infra will disable autoscaling on the VectorDB for the active cutover and will provide an ops channel during the window. Our SRE will join the runbook call and Ben's smoke test iteration on Friday the 4th to sanity-check metrics before cutover.

Docs accepted: orchestration_plan.pdf, indexing-runbook-v2.md, smoke-test-checklist.xlsx. We will send a signed SOW via DocuSign by Monday.
